name: Breathing support and MND
description: MND-specific guidance about respiratory muscle weakness, symptoms, assessment, monitoring and support options.
care_team_notes: Ask the MND clinic, respiratory physician, physiotherapist and GP about baseline respiratory testing, warning signs, cough strength and when to seek urgent help.

name: Non-invasive ventilation in MND
description: MND respiratory and NIV guidance relevant to nocturnal hypoventilation, BiPAP/NIV setup, monitoring and ongoing review.
care_team_notes: Escalate morning headaches, daytime sleepiness, breathlessness lying flat, poor sleep, repeated chest infections, weak cough or mask/interface problems to respiratory clinicians.

name: Cough strength and airway clearance
description: Guidance relevant to weak cough, secretions, mucus clearance, cough-assist discussions and chest infection risk.
care_team_notes: Discuss cough effectiveness, airway clearance techniques, secretion management, suction/cough-assist equipment and chest infection action plans with respiratory and allied health teams.

name: Breathlessness and urgent escalation
description: Australian general guidance on shortness of breath, red flags and when emergency care may be needed.
care_team_notes: Use emergency services for severe or sudden breathlessness, blue lips, chest pain, confusion, fainting or other urgent symptoms; use MND respiratory plans for known progressive symptoms.

name: Saliva and secretion management
description: MND-specific saliva and secretion guidance that may affect breathing comfort, cough, airway clearance and choking/aspiration risk.
care_team_notes: Ask speech pathology, respiratory clinicians and medical teams about saliva thickness, drooling, suction, medication options, hydration, swallowing safety and secretion clearance.
